Powell has said he wants to reduce the Fed’s past practice of pre‑guiding markets through speech and avoid surprises in decision making. Yet in a month where a hike is uncertain, any comment on the economic outlook could be read as backing a pause or paving the way for another increase.

Timiraos believes that even if Powell does not signal, investors may enter the silence period with divided views, making the final decision a surprise; the meeting is less than a week from the U.S. midterm election.

Meghan Swiber, a rate strategist at Bank of America, says investors are waiting to see whether Powell will support the Fed continuing to raise rates. She notes that this round of price increases is broad, making it harder for the Fed to ignore.

September CPI rose 3.7% year‑over‑year, with energy costs spiking and higher prices for airfare, used cars and medical care. Computer and software prices hit record annual gains, and toy prices rose at the largest rate since 1988, showing pressure beyond a single sector.

This is also the second consecutive month core inflation exceeded forecasts, contrasting with officials’ recent patient‑wait signals. Vice‑chair Jefferson, Governor H. Weller, and New York Fed President Williams had previously suggested that after the first rate hike of 2023, there was no need to act again immediately.
Timiraos notes that two weeks ago Williams and Jefferson’s conversation helped bring the October hike probability from about 70% down to about 25%; the CPI this month partially reversed that trend.

Joseph Brusuelas, chief economist at RSM US, describes the committee’s dovish members as feeling like they had taken a cold coffee after seeing September CPI. He says multiple supply shocks are broadly transmitting to the U.S. economy.

Bloomberg senior strategist Ed Harrison points out that if markets shift back to a more hawkish rate outlook, short‑term Treasury yields could face stronger selling pressure, with yield gains exceeding those of long‑term bonds, narrowing the spread; long‑term inflation expectations may also rise.

The focus is not just on when to hike but how high rates will ultimately rise. Even though the probability of an October hike has increased, most observers still expect the Fed to wait until December. Some analysts say that rising mortgage rates have stalled the housing market, and delaying action allows more time to gauge price trends and economic resilience.

Guy LeBas, chief fixed‑income strategist at Janney Montgomery Scott, says that although several price categories are hot, there is no clear evidence of acceleration; to get officials who favor gradual action to support an October hike, more convincing data is needed.

Timiraos reminds that even if rates stay unchanged in October, this report could shift the debate from “when to hike” to “how high rates should rise.” Inflation is more stubborn and widespread than expected, raising the possibility that after a December hike, the Fed may continue tightening through 2027.
If October price data shows further pressure and the Fed remains cautious this month, officials may need to decide at the December 8–9 meeting whether to raise rates by one basis point or two.

items.title: 蘋果股價創高後回落! Munster警告：智慧家庭硬體非主流 恐錯失生成式AI商機
items.title_en: Apple Stock Peaks Then Slides! Munster Warns Smart‑Home Hardware Is Not Mainstream, Risks Missing Generative AI Opportunity
paras: 蘋果 (Apple) (AAPL-US) 股價在創下歷史新高後回落, 市場焦點轉向公司能否掌握生成式人工智慧 (AI) 的下一波成長機會。Deepwater Asset Management 合夥人 Gene Munster 指出, 蘋果近期加快智慧家庭硬體產品布局, 顯示產品推出速度正在提升, 但相較於個人化 AI 助理與專用 AI 機器人, 智慧家庭硬體可能並非消費科技市場最大的成長機會。
蘋果股價周二 (13日) 盤中觸及348.15美元的歷史新高, 隨後回落, 收盤報341.27美元, 上漲0.09%。股價創高的背景, 是蘋果公布一系列智慧家庭硬體產品, 同時市場傳出即將推出的摺疊 iPhone 需求強勁, 帶動投資人重新評估公司的產品成長前景。
蘋果此次推出的智慧家庭產品包括 Home View, 這是一款配備7吋螢幕的家庭顯示裝置, 定價299美元, 可整合智慧家庭配件、電子郵件及訊息功能。蘋果也推出售價299美元的新款 Apple TV, 加入遙控器尋找功能, 並規劃名為 Home Collection 的第三方配件系列, 涵蓋智慧門鎖、攝影機等產品, 進一步擴大智慧家庭生態系。
Munster 預估, Home View 的銷量可能達到約400萬台, 為蘋果2027會計年度預估5,250億美元營收增加約15億美元, 相當於總營收的約1%。他認為, 這項產品能為公司帶來額外營收, 但相較於蘋果整體業務規模, 貢獻仍屬增量成長, 不足以單獨改變公司的成長軌跡。
Munster 在《Pressure Points》Podcast 節目中表示, 消費者目前在整合各種智慧家庭裝置時仍面臨太多操作障礙, 市場對這類產品的接受度可能尚未成熟。相較之下, 消費者已準備好使用生成式 AI, 尤其是能針對特定需求提供協助的個人化機器人。他認為, 蘋果的 Home View 雖然展現硬體產品開發速度加快, 卻可能沒有對準消費科技領域最大的機會。

他也警告, 如果消費者逐漸習慣使用競爭對手的 AI 服務, 蘋果可能被排除在相關服務營收成長之外。Meta Platforms (META-US) 的 Muse, 以及 SpaceX (SPCX-US) 相關的 Grokbot 等產品, 都可能成為消費者建立 AI 使用習慣的選項。報導指出, Grokbot 的月費為20美元。若使用者長期依賴其他平台的 AI 工具, 蘋果未來要將使用者導回自家服務, 並從 AI 應用中創造更多營收, 難度可能提高。
智慧家庭硬體之外, 摺疊 iPhone 也成為近期支撐蘋果股價的重要題材。市場報導指出, 蘋果即將推出的摺疊智慧型手機 iPhone Duo 需求預期升溫, 公司據傳已將供應鏈訂單提高30%, 使初期供應量預估達到1,000萬台, 而產品預購預計於10月16日開始。相關消息與智慧家庭新品發布共同推動蘋果股價在周二觸及歷史高點。
截至周二收盤, 蘋果股價過去一年上漲37.80%, 2026年以來上漲25.35%, 過去一個月上漲2.71%。周三盤前股價一度上漲0.44%。市場評級資料顯示, 蘋果股價短期、中期及長期趨勢仍然偏強, 但成長評分僅屬中等, 反映股價動能與未來業務成長潛力並非完全一致。
對蘋果而言, 智慧家庭硬體有助於延伸既有裝置生態系, 並增加消費者在家庭場景中使用蘋果產品的機會; 摺疊 iPhone 則可能帶來新一輪硬體換機需求。然而, Munster 的觀點凸顯另一項更重要的挑戰: 在生成式 AI 快速發展的環境下, 蘋果能否將既有硬體優勢轉化為個人化 AI 助理與服務營收, 將是影響公司長期成長的重要因素。

若蘋果只能透過新增硬體維持營收成長, 卻無法在 AI 服務及使用者互動方面建立競爭優勢, 即使產品銷售持續成長, 仍可能錯失消費科技產業下一階段的主要商機。反之, 若公司能將 AI 能力有效整合至 iPhone、智慧家庭裝置及服務生態系, 則有機會在既有用戶基礎上創造新的成長來源。市場接下來將持續觀察新品銷售表現、摺疊 iPhone 的實際需求, 以及蘋果能否在個人化 AI 領域提出更具競爭力的產品策略。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) shares fell back after hitting an all‑time high, shifting market focus to whether the company can capture the next growth wave of generative artificial intelligence (AI). Deepwater Asset Management partner Gene Munster noted that Apple has recently accelerated its rollout of smart‑home hardware, showing faster product launches, but compared with personalized AI assistants and dedicated AI robots, smart‑home hardware may not be the biggest growth opportunity in the consumer‑tech market.

Apple’s stock touched a historic high of $348.15 on Tuesday the 13th before retreating to close at $341.27, up 0.09%. The rally was sparked by Apple’s announcement of a suite of smart‑home hardware products and rumors of strong demand for an upcoming foldable iPhone, prompting investors to reassess the company’s product growth outlook.

The new smart‑home lineup includes Home View, a 7‑inch display device priced at $299 that integrates smart‑home accessories, email and messaging. Apple also unveiled a $299 Apple TV with a remote‑finder feature and announced a third‑party accessory series called Home Collection, covering smart locks, cameras and other devices to broaden the smart‑home ecosystem.

Munster estimates Home View could sell about 4 million units, adding roughly $1 billion to Apple’s FY2027 revenue forecast of $525 billion – about 1% of total revenue. He says the product can generate incremental revenue, but its contribution is modest relative to Apple’s overall scale and unlikely to shift the company’s growth trajectory on its own.

On the Pressure Points podcast, Munster said consumers still face many usability hurdles when integrating various smart‑home devices, suggesting market acceptance is not yet mature. By contrast, consumers are ready to adopt generative AI, especially personalized robots that address specific needs. He believes Apple’s Home View, while showing faster hardware development, may miss the biggest opportunity in consumer tech.

He also warned that if consumers grow accustomed to rival AI services, Apple could be left out of related service‑revenue growth. Competitors such as Meta Platforms’ Muse and SpaceX‑linked Grokbot – priced at $20 per month – could become the default AI tools for users. Long‑term reliance on other platforms would make it harder for Apple to pull users back to its own services and monetize AI applications.

Beyond smart‑home hardware, the foldable iPhone is another recent catalyst for Apple’s stock. Reports say demand for the upcoming foldable iPhone Duo is heating up, with Apple allegedly boosting supply‑chain orders by 30% to target an initial volume of 10 million units, and pre‑orders slated to start on October 16. The news, together with the smart‑home launch, helped push the stock to its Tuesday high.

As of Tuesday’s close, Apple’s share price was up 37.80% over the past year, 25.35% since the start of 2026, and 2.71% over the past month. The stock was up 0.44% in early Wednesday trading. Market ratings show short‑, medium‑ and long‑term trends remain bullish, though growth scores are only moderate, reflecting a mismatch between price momentum and future business growth potential.

For Apple, smart‑home hardware extends its existing device ecosystem and increases the likelihood that consumers use Apple products at home, while the foldable iPhone could spark a new wave of hardware upgrades. Munster’s view, however, highlights a bigger challenge: in a rapidly evolving generative‑AI landscape, Apple’s ability to turn its hardware advantage into personalized AI assistants and service revenue will be a key determinant of long‑term growth.

If Apple can only rely on new hardware to sustain revenue growth without building a competitive edge in AI services and user interaction, it may miss the next major opportunity in consumer tech even if product sales keep rising. Conversely, effectively integrating AI into iPhones, smart‑home devices and its services ecosystem could unlock new growth sources on its existing user base. The market will watch new product sales, actual demand for the foldable iPhone, and whether Apple can propose a more competitive AI strategy.

items.title: 估值上看2兆美元！Anthropic傳第3季已實現調整後獲利、營收達168億美元
items.title_en: Valuation Seen at $2 Trillion! Anthropic Says Q3 Adjusted Profit and Revenue Reached $16.8 Billion
paras: 知情人士透露，人工智慧(AI)模型開發商Anthropic在周三(14日)舉辦的閉門投資人會議中透露，第3季營收達168億美元，而且該季已實現調整後獲利，目前預定最快11月9日起的那一周正式啟動首次公開發行(IPO)的行銷活動。
《金融時報》及《彭博》等外媒引述知情人士說法報導，Anthropic周三在舊金山總部舉行的簡報會上向潛在投資人透露，第3季營運在調整後基礎上已獲利。該季營收為168億美元，與第2季的115億美元相比成長將近50%。
外媒先前曾披露，Anthropic預計最快在11月9日那周開始正式展開IPO行銷，目標是在感恩節前開始交易，並預計最晚今年底上市。
不過知情人士表示，相關討論仍在進行，上市時程也可能繼續調整。Anthropic發言人拒絕置評。
投資人對Anthropic最新營運狀況的反應，將是IPO過程中的關鍵。部分投資人在周三的會議前表示，Anthropic合理估值約落在1.8兆至2兆美元之間。
根據彭博先前的報導，Anthropic預期IPO規模將追平、或是超越SpaceX(SPCX-US)的上市規模。

OpenAI與Meta競爭升溫 AI安全疑慮成上市變數

Anthropic在今年大部分時間裡都保持強勁發展的氣勢，如今再度面臨來自OpenAI和Meta(META-US)等競爭對手的壓力。
在估值競賽方面，目前Anthropic和OpenAI勢均力敵，OpenAI近期以1.4兆美元估值為目標，尋求300億美元新一輪融資。然而，在AI代理程式發生多起失控的駭客事件之後，市場對AI安全的疑慮日益升高，可能影響到Anthropic的IPO。
另一方面，Meta Platforms(META-US)推出新款AI模型後，也成為投資人需要關注的競爭對手。Meta表示，新模型Muse Wonder與旗下前代產品相比有重大進展，在程式設計、處理金融或法律問題等能力方面，已可媲美OpenAI的ChatGPT與Anthropic的Claude。

全球IPO市場延宕增添變數

若Anthropic繼續推進IPO，將打破全球新股上市市場近期接連延後或取消上市計畫的趨勢。
資料中心營運商AirTrunk已將在新加坡上市不動產投資信託(REIT)的計畫延至明年。不久前，澳洲資料中心業者Firmus原定的IPO計畫已告吹。
paras_en: Sources familiar with the matter said AI model developer Anthropic disclosed at a closed‑door investor meeting on Wednesday (the 14th) that Q3 revenue hit $16.8 billion and the quarter posted adjusted profit, and that the company plans to kick off its IPO marketing campaign as early as the week of November 9.

The Financial Times, Bloomberg and other outlets, citing the same sources, reported that Anthropic told potential investors at a briefing at its San Francisco headquarters on Wednesday that it had turned an adjusted‑basis profit in Q3. Revenue for the quarter was $16.8 billion, up nearly 50 % from $11.5 billion in Q2.

Earlier foreign‑media reports said Anthropic expects to begin formal IPO marketing in the week of November 9, aiming to start trading before Thanksgiving and to list no later than the end of the year.
However, insiders said discussions are still ongoing and the timeline could be adjusted further. Anthropic’s spokesperson declined to comment.

Investors’ reaction to Anthropic’s latest operating results will be a key factor in the IPO process. Some investors told the Wednesday meeting that they see a reasonable valuation for Anthropic in the $1.8‑$2 trillion range.
According to earlier Bloomberg reporting, Anthropic’s IPO size is expected to match or exceed the listing size of SpaceX (SPCX‑US).
Competition with OpenAI and Meta is heating up, and AI‑safety concerns have become a variable for the listing.

In the valuation race, Anthropic and OpenAI are currently neck‑and‑neck; OpenAI recently targeted a $1.4 trillion valuation and is seeking a $30 billion new financing round. However, after several runaway AI‑agent hacking incidents, market worries about AI safety are rising and could affect Anthropic’s IPO.

On the other hand, Meta Platforms (META‑US) has launched a new AI model that investors are now watching as a competitor. Meta said its new model, Muse Wonder, shows major improvements over its predecessor and, in coding, financial‑or‑legal problem solving, can rival OpenAI’s ChatGPT and Anthropic’s Claude.
If Anthropic proceeds with its IPO, it would break the recent trend of global new‑stock listings being delayed or cancelled.

Data‑center operator AirTrunk has pushed back its plan to list a Singapore real‑estate investment trust (REIT) to next year, and not long ago Australian data‑center firm Firmus saw its IPO plan fall through.

items.title: 第7次挑戰成功！蘋果收盤市值終於站上5兆美元大關
items.title_en: Seventh Challenge Succeeds! Apple’s Closing Market Cap Finally Tops $5 Trillion
paras: 蘋果 (AAPL-US) 週三 (14 日) 逆勢上漲，收盤市值首度突破5兆美元，成為繼輝達 (NVDA-US) 之後，第二家達成這項里程碑的企業。
蘋果股價上漲0.5%，收在342.96美元，創歷史收盤新高，市值達5.005兆美元，僅次於市值約5.3兆美元的輝達。
蘋果此前曾有6次在盤中觸及5兆美元市值，但直到週三，才首次以超過這道門檻的市值收盤。
科技股承壓 蘋果逆勢創高
這項里程碑出現在科技股普遍走弱的一天，那斯達克綜合指數週三下跌約1.9%，蘋果卻逆勢創下收盤新高。今年以來，蘋果股價已上漲26%，優於標普500指數約13%的漲幅。
市場分析，蘋果的逆勢表現反映其對尋求避風港的資金仍具吸引力。
其他科技巨頭正投入龐大資本，建置人工智慧 (AI) 基礎設施，對自由現金流形成壓力；蘋果則採取較為節制的支出策略，投入金額遠低於其他大型科技同業。
iPhone需求解讀 Duo成下一場考驗
對於支撐蘋果股價的iPhone需求，外媒看法並不一致。
《AppleInsider》認為，iPhone 18 Pro的需求可能是推升市值的主要因素，並指出，儘管先前傳出零組件減產消息，蘋果股價仍在一週內由跌勢中回升。
線上訂購iPhone 18 Pro Max約需等待3週出貨。不過，相較往年，今年新機上市後，交期較晚才拉長至3週。這可能反映蘋果「供貨能力」優於預期，但交期變化仍不足以單獨判定需求強弱。
《巴隆週刊》則指出，部分數據顯示上月上市的iPhone 18 Pro需求可能不足。由於iPhone銷售是蘋果最重要的營收來源，這也使即將上市的摺疊機iPhone Duo，成為檢驗市場需求的關鍵。
蘋果上月宣布推出旗下首款摺疊智慧型手機iPhone Duo，將於週五 (16 日) 開放預購，並在10月23日正式上市，起價為1,999美元，是蘋果至今推出最昂貴的iPhone。
華爾街希望Pro系列需求偏弱，是因為消費者正在等待價格更高的Duo。若Duo上市後的需求未能支持這項期待，蘋果股價及剛達成的5兆美元市值，都可能面臨壓力。
美國銀行分析師 Wamsi Mohan 指出，投資人看好蘋果的部分原因，在於消費者願意為其產品支付更高價格，因此即使利潤率下滑，蘋果仍可能維持甚至提高整體獲利。
他還指出，蘋果新款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo 可望受到市場歡迎，搭載 AI 功能的新版 Siri 也有望帶動 iPhone 換機需求。
年底假期通常是蘋果最重要的銷售旺季，但 iPhone 18，以及可能的iPhone 18e或iPhone Air 2，將延至2027年春季推出，可能改變今年的銷售節奏。
分批推出新品可能使需求由Pro系列逐步轉向標準版，延續iPhone的營收動能。
服務業務表現，以及外界期待已久的Siri AI功能改善，也將是觀察蘋果後續成長的重要因素。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) rose against the trend on Wednesday the 14th, closing with a market cap that broke the $5 trillion barrier for the first time, becoming the second company after Nvidia (NVDA-US) to achieve this milestone.
Apple’s share price rose 0.5% to $342.96, setting a new all‑time closing high and pushing its market value to $5.005 trillion, second only to Nvidia’s roughly $5.3 trillion market cap.
Apple had previously touched a $5 trillion market value six times during trading sessions, but it was not until Wednesday that it closed above that threshold for the first time.
Tech stocks under pressure, Apple bucks the trend to set a new high

The milestone came on a day when tech stocks were broadly weakening, with the Nasdaq Composite down about 1.9% on Wednesday, yet Apple posted a new closing high against the tide. So far this year Apple’s stock has risen 26%, outpacing the S&P 500’s roughly 13% gain.
Market analysts say Apple’s contrarian performance reflects its continued appeal as a safe‑haven for capital.

Other tech giants are pouring massive capital into building AI infrastructure, putting pressure on free cash flow; Apple, by contrast, is following a more restrained spending approach, investing far less than its large‑cap peers.
iPhone demand interpretation: Duo becomes the next test
Views abroad differ on the iPhone demand that underpins Apple’s stock price.

AppleInsider believes demand for the iPhone 18 Pro could be the main driver of the market‑cap boost, noting that despite earlier rumors of component cuts, Apple’s shares rebounded within a week from a decline.

Online orders for the iPhone 18 Pro Max are expected to ship in about three weeks. However, compared with previous years, the lead time has lengthened to three weeks after the new model’s launch this year. This may indicate Apple’s supply capability is better than expected, but the change in lead time alone is insufficient to gauge demand strength.

Baron Weekly points out that some data suggest demand for the iPhone 18 Pro launched last month may be lacking. Since iPhone sales are Apple’s most important revenue source, this also makes the upcoming foldable iPhone Duo a key test of market demand.

Apple announced last month its first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, which will open for pre‑orders on Friday the 16th and officially launch on October 23 at a starting price of $1,999, making it the most expensive iPhone Apple has released to date.

Wall Street hopes the Pro‑series demand is weak because consumers are waiting for the higher‑priced Duo. If Duo’s launch demand falls short of expectations, Apple’s stock and its newly achieved $5 trillion market cap could face pressure.

Bank of America analyst Wamsi Mohan notes that part of the optimism about Apple stems from consumers’ willingness to pay higher prices for its products, so even if margins shrink, Apple could still maintain or even increase overall profitability.
He also says the new iPhone Duo is likely to be well received, and the AI‑enhanced Siri in the new version could spur iPhone upgrade cycles.

The holiday season at year‑end is usually Apple’s biggest sales period, but the iPhone 18—and possibly an iPhone 18e or iPhone Air 2—are now slated for a spring 2027 release, which could alter this year’s sales rhythm.
Staggered product rollouts may shift demand gradually from the Pro line to the standard models, sustaining iPhone revenue momentum.
Service business performance and the long‑awaited improvements to Siri’s AI capabilities will also be key indicators of Apple’s future growth.

items.title: 投資人需重整AI投資策略？高盛示警AI生態系分流、美中「雙強」格局成形
items.title_en: Should Investors Revise Their AI Investment Strategies? Goldman Sachs Warns of AI Ecosystem Split and Emerging US‑China Dual‑Power Landscape
paras: 美中人工智慧（AI）產業逐漸走向不同發展路線，可能改變全球投資人布局AI相關資產的方式。高盛最新分析指出，市場愈來愈認同全球AI產業正形成以美國與中國為核心的兩大生態系，兩者在地緣政治、國家安全及經濟成長考量下各自發展，可能是時候投資人需要重新思考AI投資策略。
根據《Business insider》報導，高盛策略師Kinger Lau領軍的團隊在週日發布的報告中指出，「全球AI雙強格局」的敘事正逐漸受到投資人關注。
策略師指出，一個AI生態系以美國及其主要貿易夥伴為核心，另一個則正在中國成形，反映地緣政治、國家安全及經濟成長等考量。
高盛指出，中國AI產業的進展已不再侷限於支援全球AI建設所需的供應鏈。從DeepSeek、Kimi等大型語言模型的突破，到半導體封裝、運算、生物工程及航太領域的進展，都顯示中國正持續擴大技術布局。
該行指出，中國也正打造涵蓋先進晶片、開放權重大型語言模型及AI應用的完整生態系，未來可能與美國主導的AI產業體系競爭。
策略師寫道：「重要的是，中國與西方之間的技術差距似乎正在縮小。」
他們還補充說，儘管中國在最先進的半導體技術方面仍落後數個世代，但在部分AI運算能力、基礎設施、模型及實體AI應用領域，中國可能已達到與全球競爭者相當的水準，甚至處於領先地位。
隨著美中AI生態系逐漸分流，高盛也調整中國AI股票的投資分類，不再將相關企業視為同一類資產，而是區分為兩大群組：一類是受惠於西方AI投資支出的出口導向企業，另一類則是受中國自身AI投資、應用普及及政策支持帶動的內需型企業。
高盛策略師指出，出口導向企業對全球AI投資趨勢及地緣政治局勢較為敏感；以中國內需市場為主的企業，則與中國AI支出及政府政策有更密切的關聯。
兩類企業的市場表現已出現差異。高盛數據顯示，從2025年初至2026年6月，中國AI出口導向企業股價累計上漲126%，但在全球AI股票遭遇賣壓期間，股價也從高點回落23%。
相較之下，中國內需型AI企業在市場修正後展現較強韌性。
高盛指出，自2025年初DeepSeek引發市場關注以來，受惠於股價上漲及新股上市，中國AI相關上市公司的市值合計增加近5兆美元。
AI相關股票在中國股市中的重要性也持續提高。高盛指出，目前中國境內及香港上市的中國股票，其合計股市總市值中，AI相關股票占比已從2024年的24%升至42%。
同時，AI相關股票的成交額占比也從48%升至57%。
paras_en: U.S. and Chinese artificial intelligence (AI) industries are gradually taking divergent development paths, which could reshape how global investors allocate AI‑related assets. Goldman Sachs' latest analysis notes that the market is increasingly recognizing two major AI ecosystems centered on the United States and China, each evolving under geopolitical, national‑security and growth considerations, and investors may need to rethink their AI strategies.

According to Business Insider, a Goldman Sachs team led by strategist Kinger Lau released a report on Sunday highlighting that the narrative of a "global AI dual‑power landscape" is gaining investor attention.

The strategists point out that one AI ecosystem is anchored by the United States and its key trading partners, while another is coalescing around China, reflecting geopolitical, security and growth factors.

Goldman notes that China's AI progress is no longer limited to supporting the global AI supply chain. Breakthroughs from large language models such as DeepSeek and Kimi, as well as advances in semiconductor packaging, computing, biotech and aerospace, show China is expanding its technological footprint.

The firm adds that China is building a complete ecosystem that includes advanced chips, open‑weight large language models and AI applications, which could eventually compete with the U.S.‑led AI industry framework.
The strategists write: "Importantly, the technology gap between China and the West appears to be narrowing."

They further note that although China still lags several generations behind in the most advanced semiconductor technology, it may have reached parity—or even leadership—in certain AI compute capabilities, infrastructure, models and physical AI applications compared with global rivals.

As the U.S. and Chinese AI ecosystems diverge, Goldman has re‑classified Chinese AI stocks, no longer treating them as a single asset class but splitting them into two groups: export‑oriented firms that benefit from Western AI investment spending, and domestic‑demand firms driven by China’s own AI investment, adoption and policy support.

The strategists say export‑oriented companies are more sensitive to global AI investment trends and geopolitical dynamics, while firms focused on China’s domestic market are more closely tied to Chinese AI spending and government policy.

The two groups have already shown different market performance. Goldman data show that from early 2025 to June 2026, Chinese AI export‑oriented stocks rose 126% cumulatively, but fell 23% from their peaks during a period of global AI stock sell‑off.
In contrast, Chinese domestic‑demand AI firms displayed greater resilience after the market correction.

Goldman points out that since DeepSeek attracted market attention in early 2025, the combined market capitalization of listed Chinese AI companies has grown by nearly $5 trillion, boosted by price gains and new listings.

AI‑related stocks are becoming increasingly important in China’s equity markets. Goldman notes that AI stocks now account for 42% of the total market value of China‑ and Hong Kong‑listed Chinese shares, up from 24% in 2024.
At the same time, the share of trading volume attributable to AI stocks has risen from 48% to 57%.

items.title: 戴爾重挫11%標普吊車尾 分析師質疑上漲空間有限
items.title_en: Dell plunges 11% as S&P lagging; analysts question limited upside
paras: 《MarketWatch》週三(14日)報導，戴爾科技(Dell Technologies)(DELL-US)與慧與科技(Hewlett Packard Enterprise)(HPE-US)股價今年表現亮眼，但有分析師質疑，這兩檔股票的後續上漲空間是否已經有限。
戴爾在2026年至今上漲逾300%，慧與科技則上漲163%。兩家公司都銷售AI伺服器，在需求大幅攀升帶動下，未交貨訂單積壓量也持續增加。不過，巴克萊分析師Tim Long質疑，這兩檔股票的漲勢是否真的如投資人所想，主要受到人工智慧題材推動。
Long認為，戴爾「與AI投資趨勢相當一致」，但他將戴爾股價出色的表現，主要歸因於公司抵銷記憶體價格變動影響的能力。
戴爾憑藉用於AI最佳化的資料中心伺服器，受惠於AI熱潮。Long預估，這項業務在截至明年1月的本會計年度，營收將成長至750億美元，達到原先的三倍。
然而，Long表示，記憶體價格可能逐漸回歸正常水準，甚至可能在未來兩年開始下跌，進而拖慢戴爾AI伺服器營收的成長速度。他補充，這也可能限制戴爾股價進一步上漲的空間。
Long將戴爾股票評級從加碼下調至中立，並將目標價從603美元下修至574美元。戴爾股價週三收盤下跌11.4%，至507.43美元，在標普500指數成分股中，跌幅第二大。
根據道瓊市場數據，戴爾股價週三的單日跌幅，創下2025年4月3日下跌19%以來最大紀錄。
Long表示，慧與科技的伺服器與儲存業務，也受惠於記憶體零組件平均售價上升。因此，隨著相關成本回歸正常水準，他預期該公司股價未來的上漲空間將更加有限。他同樣將慧與科技的股票評級下調至中立。
Long表示，他目前尚未在這兩家公司身上「看到AI帶來的顯著轉折」。他原先預期，企業採用AI將帶動對更多相關硬體的需求，進而推升營收。然而，目前為止，記憶體成本對企業相關營收的影響，比企業轉向AI所帶來的影響更大。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported on Wednesday (the 14th) that Dell Technologies (DELL‑US) and Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE‑US) have posted standout stock performance this year, but some analysts wonder whether further upside for the two stocks is now limited.

Dell has risen more than 300% since 2026, while HPE is up 163%. Both companies sell AI servers, and the surge in demand has driven a growing backlog of undelivered orders. However, Barclays analyst Tim Long questions whether the rally in these stocks is truly driven by the AI theme as investors believe.

Long says Dell’s performance is “very much in line with the AI investment trend,” but he attributes the stock’s strong gains mainly to the company’s ability to offset the impact of memory‑price fluctuations.

Dell benefits from AI‑optimized data‑center servers riding the AI boom. Long forecasts that this business will generate $75 billion in revenue for the fiscal year ending January next year, roughly three times its current level.

Long cautions that memory prices may gradually normalize and could even start to decline over the next two years, which would slow the growth rate of Dell’s AI‑server revenue and could cap further stock appreciation.

Long downgraded Dell’s rating from “add” to “neutral” and cut the price target from $603 to $574. Dell’s shares closed down 11.4% on Wednesday at $507.43, the second‑largest decline among S&P 500 constituents.
According to Dow Jones market data, Dell’s single‑day drop on Wednesday was the biggest since a 19% fall on April 3, 2025.

Long noted that HPE’s server and storage businesses have also benefited from higher average selling prices for memory components. As those costs return to normal, he expects the company’s upside potential to become even more limited and has similarly lowered HPE’s rating to neutral.

Long said he has not yet seen a “significant AI‑driven inflection” at either company. He originally expected corporate AI adoption to spur demand for more related hardware and boost revenue, but so far the impact of memory costs on corporate revenue has outweighed the effect of the shift toward AI.

items.title: AI資料中心需求強勁卻難蓋! 馬斯克: 籌到錢只是第一關 電力、散熱與網路都是瓶頸
items.title_en: Strong AI Data Center Demand Yet Hard to Build! Musk: Raising Money Is Only the First Hurdle, Power, Cooling and Network Are Bottlenecks
paras: 馬斯克警告, 人工智慧 (AI) 資料中心市場雖然需求強勁, 但取得資金並不代表企業就能順利完成建置。SpaceX 創辦人馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 近日指出, 建造超級電腦資料中心涉及龐大的電力、散熱及網路系統, 工程複雜程度遠超單純籌資, 即使 SpaceX 擁有頂尖團隊, 仍發現相關建置工作極具挑戰。
馬斯克周二 (13日) 在社群平台 X 發文表示, 「超級電腦資料中心的需求確實非常強勁, 但取得資金來建造具有龐大電力、散熱及網路需求的複雜硬體系統, 與真正把它建造出來並不是同一回事。」他並指出, SpaceX 擁有實力非常強大的團隊, 在軌道運載能力方面領先其他業者一個數量級, 但即使如此, 要完成這些建設仍然非常困難。
馬斯克的發言, 是針對市場對 AI 基礎設施融資風險升高的討論所作出的回應。近年科技企業大舉投入 AI 運算能力, 推動資料中心、伺服器、晶片及電力設施的資本支出快速增加, 但投資人開始更加關注企業能否將鉅額融資轉化為實際營運能力與現金流。

AI 雲端運算服務商 CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 與甲骨文 (Oracle) (ORCL-US) 都是 AI 基礎設施擴建的重要參與者, 但市場對相關企業的負債、融資成本及未來投資回報愈來愈謹慎。CoreWeave 的2032年到期債券殖利率近期一度升至約15%, 顯示債券投資人要求更高報酬, 以承擔企業擴張及信用風險。市場也開始質疑, 若 AI 運算需求成長不如預期, 或資料中心建置進度落後, 業者是否仍能負擔龐大的利息及資本支出。

馬斯克的警告也與 SpaceX 自身的 AI 基礎設施計畫密切相關。SpaceX 正積極擴大超級電腦與資料中心建置, 並尋求大量資金採購輝達 (NVIDIA) (NVDA-US) 的 AI 晶片。根據《路透社》先前報導, SpaceX 正尋求約400億美元融資採購輝達晶片, 規劃透過銀行貸款籌集約100億美元, 另發行約300億美元投資級債券。這項融資規模凸顯, 建置先進 AI 運算基礎設施所需的資本已達到數百億美元等級。

在實際建置方面, SpaceX 旗下的 Colossus 超級電腦最初在122天內完成建置, 之後擴充至搭載20萬顆輝達 H100 GPU, 並規劃進一步將運算規模提升至100萬顆 GPU。馬斯克也曾表示, Colossus 2 未來可能搭載超過120萬顆輝達 GB200 與 GB300 晶片。這些計畫顯示, AI 運算能力的擴張不只是採購晶片, 還必須同步完成機房、供電、散熱、網路及其他配套系統。
特斯拉 (Tesla) (TSLA-US) 也持續擴大 AI 運算設施。公司第二季文件指出, 位於德州的 Cortex 1 與 Cortex 2 系統提供超過205百萬瓦的生產運算能力, 並計畫在年底前進一步擴建。如此大規模的運算設施需要穩定且充足的電力供應, 同時必須有效管理晶片產生的熱量, 以維持設備運作與系統可靠性。
資料中心產業的挑戰不僅在於資金與硬體, 電力取得、冷卻效率及高速網路連接同樣可能限制建置速度。即使企業已經取得晶片訂單與融資承諾, 若電網接入、供電設施、冷卻系統或網路設備無法及時到位, 整座資料中心仍可能無法按計畫投入營運。這也意味著, AI 基礎設施投資的成敗, 不只取決於企業能投入多少資本, 更取決於工程執行、設備整合及營運管理能力。
馬斯克的布局甚至延伸至太空資料中心。SpaceX 計畫利用太陽能供電、輻射散熱及 Starlink 雷射通訊鏈路, 探索在軌道部署 AI 運算設施, 以降低地面資料中心對土地、電網及傳統冷卻設備的依賴。馬斯克認為, 太空可能是未來大規模擴展運算能力的重要方向之一。
然而, 太空資料中心仍面臨極高的工程與經濟門檻。設備必須承受嚴苛的太空環境, 高效能晶片的散熱方式也與地面機房不同, 此外還涉及發射成本、設備維修及硬體升級等問題。即使 SpaceX 擁有火箭發射與衛星網路技術優勢, 要將這些能力轉化為具商業可行性的太空運算服務, 仍需要克服多項技術障礙。
對 AI 資料中心投資人而言, 馬斯克的說法凸顯產業評價標準正在改變。過去市場主要關注晶片供應、運算需求及企業能否取得資金, 如今隨著投資規模持續擴大, 電力、散熱、網路、建置時程與融資成本也成為決定投資回報的重要因素。
AI 運算需求持續成長, 並不代表所有資料中心業者都能順利獲利。企業即使取得大量融資, 若建置進度延誤、營運成本過高, 或客戶需求無法支撐預期收入, 仍可能面臨現金流壓力。隨著市場對 AI 基礎設施投資的審查日益嚴格, 投資人除了評估資金規模及晶片採購能力, 也必須檢視企業的工程執行力、基礎設施建置效率及長期獲利能力。
paras_en: Musk warned that although the AI data‑center market is booming, securing financing does not guarantee a company can complete construction. SpaceX founder Elon Musk recently pointed out that building super‑computer data centers involves massive power, cooling and networking systems, and the engineering complexity far exceeds simple fundraising; even with SpaceX’s top‑tier team, the related work remains highly challenging.

Musk posted on X on Tuesday the 13th that “the demand for super‑computer data centers is indeed very strong, but raising money to build hardware systems with huge power, cooling and networking needs is not the same as actually building them.” He added that SpaceX has an exceptionally strong team and leads other players by an order of magnitude in orbital launch capability, yet completing these builds is still extremely difficult.

Musk’s remarks were a response to growing discussion about rising financing risk for AI infrastructure. In recent years tech firms have poured capital into AI compute, driving rapid growth in data‑center, server, chip and power‑facility spending, but investors are now scrutinizing whether companies can turn massive financing into real operating capacity and cash flow.

AI cloud providers CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) and Oracle (ORCL‑US) are key players in AI infrastructure expansion, but the market is becoming more cautious about their debt, financing costs and future returns. CoreWeave’s 2032 bond yield recently spiked to about 15%, indicating investors demand higher compensation for expansion and credit risk. The market also questions whether firms can shoulder large interest and cap‑ex bills if AI demand falls short or data‑center roll‑outs lag.

Musk’s warning is closely tied to SpaceX’s own AI infrastructure plans. SpaceX is actively expanding super‑computers and data centers and seeking massive funding to buy NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) AI chips. Reuters previously reported that SpaceX is looking for roughly $40 billion in financing to purchase NVIDIA chips, planning about $10 billion in bank loans and issuing about $30 billion of investment‑grade bonds. This financing scale highlights that capital needed for advanced AI compute infrastructure now runs into the hundreds of billions of dollars.

In practice, SpaceX’s Colossus super‑computer was built in an initial 122‑day sprint, then expanded to house 200,000 NVIDIA H100 GPUs, with plans to scale to one million GPUs. Musk has also said that a future Colossus 2 could host over 1.2 million NVIDIA GB200 and GB300 chips. These plans show that expanding AI compute power is not just about buying chips but also completing data‑hall, power, cooling, networking and other supporting systems in tandem.

Tesla (TSLA‑US) is also expanding its AI compute facilities. Its Q2 filing noted that the Cortex 1 and Cortex 2 systems in Texas provide more than 205 MW of production compute capacity, with further expansion planned before year‑end. Such large‑scale facilities require stable, ample power supply and effective heat management to keep equipment running and systems reliable.

The data‑center industry’s challenges go beyond capital and hardware; power availability, cooling efficiency and high‑speed network connectivity can also limit build speed. Even if a company secures chip orders and financing commitments, a lack of grid connection, power infrastructure, cooling systems or network gear can prevent a data center from becoming operational on schedule. Thus the success of AI infrastructure investment depends not only on how much capital a firm can raise but also on engineering execution, equipment integration and operational management.

Musk’s vision even extends to space‑based data centers. SpaceX plans to use solar power, radiation cooling and Starlink laser links to explore orbital AI compute deployments, reducing reliance on land, grid and traditional cooling for ground data centers. Musk believes space could become a major avenue for massive compute expansion in the future.

However, space data centers face extremely high engineering and economic barriers. Equipment must survive harsh space conditions, and high‑performance chip cooling differs from ground‑based solutions; launch costs, maintenance and hardware upgrades also add complexity. Even with SpaceX’s launch and satellite‑network advantages, turning these capabilities into commercially viable space compute services will require overcoming numerous technical hurdles.

For AI data‑center investors, Musk’s comments highlight a shift in industry valuation criteria. Previously the market focused mainly on chip supply, compute demand and a firm’s ability to raise money; now, as investment scales grow, power, cooling, networking, build timelines and financing costs have become key determinants of investment returns.

Growing AI compute demand does not guarantee profitability for all data‑center operators. Even with abundant financing, companies can face cash‑flow pressure if build schedules slip, operating costs soar, or customer demand falls short of revenue expectations. As scrutiny of AI infrastructure investments tightens, investors must assess not only funding size and chip‑buying capacity but also a firm’s engineering execution, infrastructure build efficiency and long‑term profit potential.

items.title: 營收季增45%仍不夠？Anthropic衝刺2兆美元IPO，5,180億美元算力支出成關鍵考驗
items.title_en: Revenue Up 45% Quarterly Still Not Enough? Anthropic Pushes for $2 Trillion IPO, $518 Billion Compute Spend Becomes Key Test
paras: 2026年10月15日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 生成式AI公司Anthropic營收快速成長，2026年第3季營收達168億美元，較第2季的116億美元成長45%，並在調整後基礎上實現單季獲利。隨著公司準備以超過2兆美元的估值進行首次公開募股(IPO)，市場關注焦點也從AI模型的營收成長速度，逐漸轉向龐大的算力支出能否轉化為持續獲利。
這些財務數據來自Anthropic於10月14日在舊金山舉行的上市前投資人說明會。出席投資人透露，公司2026年第1季營收為47億美元，第2季增至116億美元，第3季進一步攀升至168億美元，顯示旗下Claude系列AI模型的商業化規模持續擴大。
不過，營收快速成長並不代表AI開發商已擺脫高成本壓力。Anthropic在2025年營收擴大至前一年的約12倍，達46億美元，但排除主要與過往募資相關的負債減記影響後，營業虧損仍超過80億美元。儘管公司透露2026年第3季已實現調整後獲利，但尚未公布完整財務報表，因此無法確認是否已達到一般公認會計原則(GAAP)下的淨利轉正。
造成龐大成本壓力的關鍵，在於先進AI模型需要持續投入大量運算資源。為了支撐模型訓練、推論及產品服務，Anthropic已承諾未來10年至少支出5,180億美元，用於雲端服務、運算能力及基礎設施。這也使公司面臨一項重要挑戰：即使AI應用需求快速增加，營收成長能否持續超越模型開發與運作成本，仍是支撐高估值的關鍵。
Anthropic的擴張也高度依賴大型科技公司的支持。Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)與亞馬遜Amazon(AMZN-US)不僅是Anthropic的投資人，同時也是運算資源供應商及重要的產品銷售合作夥伴，但雙方也各自發展AI服務，與Anthropic存在競爭關係。這種同時涵蓋投資、算力供應與市場競爭的合作模式，反映先進AI開發商對大型雲端平台的高度依賴。
Anthropic目前正積極籌備IPO，目標估值超過2兆美元，上市時間可能延至2026年11月美國期中選舉之後，並有機會早於競爭對手OpenAI掛牌。若順利上市，Anthropic將成為市場檢視大型生成式AI開發商營收成長、獲利能力及算力支出結構的重要案例。

paras_en: October 15, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Generative‑AI company Anthropic is seeing rapid revenue growth, with Q3 2026 revenue reaching $16.8 billion, a 45% increase from $11.6 billion in Q2, and achieving adjusted quarterly profit. As the company prepares for an IPO at a valuation exceeding $2 trillion, market focus is shifting from the speed of AI‑model revenue growth to whether its massive compute spending can be turned into sustained profitability.

These financial figures were disclosed at Anthropic’s pre‑IPO investor briefing held in San Francisco on October 14. Attending investors said the company posted $4.7 billion in revenue for Q1 2026, $11.6 billion in Q2, and $16.8 billion in Q3, indicating the commercial scale of its Claude series AI models continues to expand.

However, fast‑growing revenue does not mean AI developers have escaped high‑cost pressures. Anthropic’s 2025 revenue ballooned to about 12 times the prior year, reaching $4.6 billion, yet after stripping out debt write‑downs tied to earlier fundraising, operating losses still exceeded $8 billion. Although the firm said it achieved adjusted profit in Q3 2026, a full set of financial statements has not been released, so it cannot be confirmed whether net income is positive under GAAP.

The source of the cost pressure is the need for massive compute resources to support advanced AI models. To fund model training, inference and product services, Anthropic has pledged to spend at least $518 billion over the next ten years on cloud services, compute capacity and infrastructure. This creates a key challenge: even as demand for AI applications surges, can revenue growth continue to outpace the costs of model development and operation, a crucial factor for sustaining a lofty valuation?

Anthropic’s expansion relies heavily on support from large tech firms. Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Google’s parent, and Amazon (AMZN‑US) are not only investors but also providers of compute resources and important product‑sales partners, yet both companies are developing their own AI services and compete with Anthropic. This mixed relationship—investment, compute supply and market competition—highlights the deep dependence of advanced AI developers on major cloud platforms.

Anthropic is actively preparing for an IPO targeting a valuation above $2 trillion, with a listing possibly pushed to after the U.S. midterm elections in November 2026, and it could go public before rival OpenAI. If the IPO proceeds, Anthropic will become a key case study for the market to assess revenue growth, profitability and compute‑spending structures of large generative‑AI developers.

items.title: Fed緘默期前最後發聲！華許周五談話牽動10月升息押注
items.title_en: Fed’s Final Speech Before the Silence Period! Powell’s Friday Talk Influences October Rate‑Hike Bets
paras: 美國9月通膨高於預期，讓聯準會(Fed)10月是否升息再添懸念，也將市場目光推向主席華許即將在曼谷發表的談話。這是Fed進入決策前緘默期之前，官員最後一場預定公開談話，華許如何解讀通膨，可能左右市場對本月利率決策的預期。
綜合外媒報導，9月核心通膨高於預估，推升10月升息機率，一度由數據公布前約20%跳升至50%至55%，周三稍晚回落至約40%或略低。多數Fed觀察人士仍預期本月按兵不動、12月再升息，但最新數據已讓10月決策更難預判。

緘默期前最後發聲 華許難避市場解讀

《華爾街日報》記者、「Fed傳聲筒」Nick Timiraos指出，華許預定美東時間周四(15日)深夜11時30分，也就是台灣時間周五(16日)上午11時30分，與國際貨幣基金(IMF)總裁喬治艾娃進行對談。Fed將於周六(16日)進入10月27日至28日決策會議前的緘默期。
華許曾表明，希望減少過去Fed主席透過言論預先引導市場、避免決策帶來意外的做法。然而，在本月升息與否更難判斷之際，他對經濟前景的任何表態，都可能被解讀為支持暫停升息，或為再次升息鋪路。
Timiraos認為，即使華許不釋出訊號，也可能讓投資人帶著分歧進入緘默期，使最終決策令不少人意外；而這場會議距離美國期中選舉不到一周。
美國銀行(BAC-US)利率策略師Meghan Swiber表示，投資人正等待華許是否支持Fed繼續升息。她認為，這次物價上漲涵蓋範圍廣泛，Fed將更難忽視。

通膨壓力遍及商品服務 官員觀望立場受考驗

9月CPI年增3.7%，除能源成本大漲，機票、中古車與醫療照護價格也較前月走高。電腦與軟體價格年增幅創紀錄，玩具價格年增幅則為1988年以來最大，顯示壓力不限於單一領域。
這也是核心通膨連續第二個月高於預測，與官員近期釋出的耐心觀望訊號形成反差。副主席傑佛遜、理事華勒及紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯先前均暗示，9月完成2023年以來首次升息後，不必急於再度行動。
Timiraos指出，兩周前威廉斯與傑佛森的談話，曾協助將10月升息機率由約70%壓低至約25%，此次CPI則部分扭轉這項走勢。
RSM US首席經濟學家Joseph Brusuelas形容，委員會內的鴿派看到9月CPI，恐怕猶如喝到一杯冷咖啡。他認為，多重供給衝擊正廣泛傳導至美國經濟。
《彭博》總體策略師Ed Harrison則指出，若市場重新轉向更鷹派的利率預期，短天期美債可能面臨更大賣壓，殖利率升幅超過長天期，壓縮長短債利差；長期通膨預期是否走高，也值得留意。

焦點不只何時升息 還有利率最終升多高

儘管10月升息可能性提高，多數觀察人士仍預期Fed等到12月才行動。部分分析師認為，房貸利率持續上升，已使房市陷入僵局，延後決策可爭取更多時間，判斷物價走勢與經濟承受能力。
Janney Montgomery Scott首席固定收益策略師Guy LeBas表示，多個價格類別雖然偏熱，卻未見明確加速證據；要讓主張緩步行動的官員支持10月升息，仍需要更具說服力的數據。
Timiraos則提醒，即使10月維持利率不變，這份報告也可能將辯論焦點由「何時升息」推向「利率要升多高」。通膨比預期更頑強、涵蓋範圍更廣，增加Fed在12月升息後，於2027年繼續緊縮的可能性。
若下月公布的10月物價數據顯示壓力進一步增強，而Fed本月又選擇觀望，官員屆時可能須在12月8日至9日會議上，討論究竟升息1碼，還是一次升息2碼。

Powell has said he wants to reduce the Fed’s past practice of pre‑guiding markets through speech and avoid surprises in decision making. Yet in a month where a hike is uncertain, any comment on the economic outlook could be read as backing a pause or paving the way for another increase.

Timiraos believes that even if Powell does not signal, investors may enter the silence period with divided views, making the final decision a surprise; the meeting is less than a week from the U.S. midterm election.

Meghan Swiber, a rate strategist at Bank of America, says investors are waiting to see whether Powell will support the Fed continuing to raise rates. She notes that this round of price increases is broad, making it harder for the Fed to ignore.

September CPI rose 3.7% year‑over‑year, with energy costs spiking and higher prices for airfare, used cars and medical care. Computer and software prices hit record annual gains, and toy prices rose at the largest rate since 1988, showing pressure beyond a single sector.

This is also the second consecutive month core inflation exceeded forecasts, contrasting with officials’ recent patient‑wait signals. Vice‑chair Jefferson, Governor H. Weller, and New York Fed President Williams had previously suggested that after the first rate hike of 2023, there was no need to act again immediately.
Timiraos notes that two weeks ago Williams and Jefferson’s conversation helped bring the October hike probability from about 70% down to about 25%; the CPI this month partially reversed that trend.

Joseph Brusuelas, chief economist at RSM US, describes the committee’s dovish members as feeling like they had taken a cold coffee after seeing September CPI. He says multiple supply shocks are broadly transmitting to the U.S. economy.

Bloomberg senior strategist Ed Harrison points out that if markets shift back to a more hawkish rate outlook, short‑term Treasury yields could face stronger selling pressure, with yield gains exceeding those of long‑term bonds, narrowing the spread; long‑term inflation expectations may also rise.

The focus is not just on when to hike but how high rates will ultimately rise. Even though the probability of an October hike has increased, most observers still expect the Fed to wait until December. Some analysts say that rising mortgage rates have stalled the housing market, and delaying action allows more time to gauge price trends and economic resilience.

Guy LeBas, chief fixed‑income strategist at Janney Montgomery Scott, says that although several price categories are hot, there is no clear evidence of acceleration; to get officials who favor gradual action to support an October hike, more convincing data is needed.

Timiraos reminds that even if rates stay unchanged in October, this report could shift the debate from “when to hike” to “how high rates should rise.” Inflation is more stubborn and widespread than expected, raising the possibility that after a December hike, the Fed may continue tightening through 2027.
If October price data shows further pressure and the Fed remains cautious this month, officials may need to decide at the December 8–9 meeting whether to raise rates by one basis point or two.

items.title: 蘋果股價創高後回落! Munster警告：智慧家庭硬體非主流 恐錯失生成式AI商機
items.title_en: Apple Stock Peaks Then Slides! Munster Warns Smart‑Home Hardware Is Not Mainstream, Risks Missing Generative AI Opportunity
paras: 蘋果 (Apple) (AAPL-US) 股價在創下歷史新高後回落, 市場焦點轉向公司能否掌握生成式人工智慧 (AI) 的下一波成長機會。Deepwater Asset Management 合夥人 Gene Munster 指出, 蘋果近期加快智慧家庭硬體產品布局, 顯示產品推出速度正在提升, 但相較於個人化 AI 助理與專用 AI 機器人, 智慧家庭硬體可能並非消費科技市場最大的成長機會。
蘋果股價周二 (13日) 盤中觸及348.15美元的歷史新高, 隨後回落, 收盤報341.27美元, 上漲0.09%。股價創高的背景, 是蘋果公布一系列智慧家庭硬體產品, 同時市場傳出即將推出的摺疊 iPhone 需求強勁, 帶動投資人重新評估公司的產品成長前景。
蘋果此次推出的智慧家庭產品包括 Home View, 這是一款配備7吋螢幕的家庭顯示裝置, 定價299美元, 可整合智慧家庭配件、電子郵件及訊息功能。蘋果也推出售價299美元的新款 Apple TV, 加入遙控器尋找功能, 並規劃名為 Home Collection 的第三方配件系列, 涵蓋智慧門鎖、攝影機等產品, 進一步擴大智慧家庭生態系。
Munster 預估, Home View 的銷量可能達到約400萬台, 為蘋果2027會計年度預估5,250億美元營收增加約15億美元, 相當於總營收的約1%。他認為, 這項產品能為公司帶來額外營收, 但相較於蘋果整體業務規模, 貢獻仍屬增量成長, 不足以單獨改變公司的成長軌跡。
Munster 在《Pressure Points》Podcast 節目中表示, 消費者目前在整合各種智慧家庭裝置時仍面臨太多操作障礙, 市場對這類產品的接受度可能尚未成熟。相較之下, 消費者已準備好使用生成式 AI, 尤其是能針對特定需求提供協助的個人化機器人。他認為, 蘋果的 Home View 雖然展現硬體產品開發速度加快, 卻可能沒有對準消費科技領域最大的機會。

他也警告, 如果消費者逐漸習慣使用競爭對手的 AI 服務, 蘋果可能被排除在相關服務營收成長之外。Meta Platforms (META-US) 的 Muse, 以及 SpaceX (SPCX-US) 相關的 Grokbot 等產品, 都可能成為消費者建立 AI 使用習慣的選項。報導指出, Grokbot 的月費為20美元。若使用者長期依賴其他平台的 AI 工具, 蘋果未來要將使用者導回自家服務, 並從 AI 應用中創造更多營收, 難度可能提高。
智慧家庭硬體之外, 摺疊 iPhone 也成為近期支撐蘋果股價的重要題材。市場報導指出, 蘋果即將推出的摺疊智慧型手機 iPhone Duo 需求預期升溫, 公司據傳已將供應鏈訂單提高30%, 使初期供應量預估達到1,000萬台, 而產品預購預計於10月16日開始。相關消息與智慧家庭新品發布共同推動蘋果股價在周二觸及歷史高點。
截至周二收盤, 蘋果股價過去一年上漲37.80%, 2026年以來上漲25.35%, 過去一個月上漲2.71%。周三盤前股價一度上漲0.44%。市場評級資料顯示, 蘋果股價短期、中期及長期趨勢仍然偏強, 但成長評分僅屬中等, 反映股價動能與未來業務成長潛力並非完全一致。
對蘋果而言, 智慧家庭硬體有助於延伸既有裝置生態系, 並增加消費者在家庭場景中使用蘋果產品的機會; 摺疊 iPhone 則可能帶來新一輪硬體換機需求。然而, Munster 的觀點凸顯另一項更重要的挑戰: 在生成式 AI 快速發展的環境下, 蘋果能否將既有硬體優勢轉化為個人化 AI 助理與服務營收, 將是影響公司長期成長的重要因素。

若蘋果只能透過新增硬體維持營收成長, 卻無法在 AI 服務及使用者互動方面建立競爭優勢, 即使產品銷售持續成長, 仍可能錯失消費科技產業下一階段的主要商機。反之, 若公司能將 AI 能力有效整合至 iPhone、智慧家庭裝置及服務生態系, 則有機會在既有用戶基礎上創造新的成長來源。市場接下來將持續觀察新品銷售表現、摺疊 iPhone 的實際需求, 以及蘋果能否在個人化 AI 領域提出更具競爭力的產品策略。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) shares fell back after hitting an all‑time high, shifting market focus to whether the company can capture the next growth wave of generative artificial intelligence (AI). Deepwater Asset Management partner Gene Munster noted that Apple has recently accelerated its rollout of smart‑home hardware, showing faster product launches, but compared with personalized AI assistants and dedicated AI robots, smart‑home hardware may not be the biggest growth opportunity in the consumer‑tech market.

Apple’s stock touched a historic high of $348.15 on Tuesday the 13th before retreating to close at $341.27, up 0.09%. The rally was sparked by Apple’s announcement of a suite of smart‑home hardware products and rumors of strong demand for an upcoming foldable iPhone, prompting investors to reassess the company’s product growth outlook.

The new smart‑home lineup includes Home View, a 7‑inch display device priced at $299 that integrates smart‑home accessories, email and messaging. Apple also unveiled a $299 Apple TV with a remote‑finder feature and announced a third‑party accessory series called Home Collection, covering smart locks, cameras and other devices to broaden the smart‑home ecosystem.

Munster estimates Home View could sell about 4 million units, adding roughly $1 billion to Apple’s FY2027 revenue forecast of $525 billion – about 1% of total revenue. He says the product can generate incremental revenue, but its contribution is modest relative to Apple’s overall scale and unlikely to shift the company’s growth trajectory on its own.

On the Pressure Points podcast, Munster said consumers still face many usability hurdles when integrating various smart‑home devices, suggesting market acceptance is not yet mature. By contrast, consumers are ready to adopt generative AI, especially personalized robots that address specific needs. He believes Apple’s Home View, while showing faster hardware development, may miss the biggest opportunity in consumer tech.

He also warned that if consumers grow accustomed to rival AI services, Apple could be left out of related service‑revenue growth. Competitors such as Meta Platforms’ Muse and SpaceX‑linked Grokbot – priced at $20 per month – could become the default AI tools for users. Long‑term reliance on other platforms would make it harder for Apple to pull users back to its own services and monetize AI applications.

Beyond smart‑home hardware, the foldable iPhone is another recent catalyst for Apple’s stock. Reports say demand for the upcoming foldable iPhone Duo is heating up, with Apple allegedly boosting supply‑chain orders by 30% to target an initial volume of 10 million units, and pre‑orders slated to start on October 16. The news, together with the smart‑home launch, helped push the stock to its Tuesday high.

As of Tuesday’s close, Apple’s share price was up 37.80% over the past year, 25.35% since the start of 2026, and 2.71% over the past month. The stock was up 0.44% in early Wednesday trading. Market ratings show short‑, medium‑ and long‑term trends remain bullish, though growth scores are only moderate, reflecting a mismatch between price momentum and future business growth potential.

For Apple, smart‑home hardware extends its existing device ecosystem and increases the likelihood that consumers use Apple products at home, while the foldable iPhone could spark a new wave of hardware upgrades. Munster’s view, however, highlights a bigger challenge: in a rapidly evolving generative‑AI landscape, Apple’s ability to turn its hardware advantage into personalized AI assistants and service revenue will be a key determinant of long‑term growth.

If Apple can only rely on new hardware to sustain revenue growth without building a competitive edge in AI services and user interaction, it may miss the next major opportunity in consumer tech even if product sales keep rising. Conversely, effectively integrating AI into iPhones, smart‑home devices and its services ecosystem could unlock new growth sources on its existing user base. The market will watch new product sales, actual demand for the foldable iPhone, and whether Apple can propose a more competitive AI strategy.

items.title: 估值上看2兆美元！Anthropic傳第3季已實現調整後獲利、營收達168億美元
items.title_en: Valuation Seen at $2 Trillion! Anthropic Says Q3 Adjusted Profit and Revenue Reached $16.8 Billion
paras: 知情人士透露，人工智慧(AI)模型開發商Anthropic在周三(14日)舉辦的閉門投資人會議中透露，第3季營收達168億美元，而且該季已實現調整後獲利，目前預定最快11月9日起的那一周正式啟動首次公開發行(IPO)的行銷活動。
《金融時報》及《彭博》等外媒引述知情人士說法報導，Anthropic周三在舊金山總部舉行的簡報會上向潛在投資人透露，第3季營運在調整後基礎上已獲利。該季營收為168億美元，與第2季的115億美元相比成長將近50%。
外媒先前曾披露，Anthropic預計最快在11月9日那周開始正式展開IPO行銷，目標是在感恩節前開始交易，並預計最晚今年底上市。
不過知情人士表示，相關討論仍在進行，上市時程也可能繼續調整。Anthropic發言人拒絕置評。
投資人對Anthropic最新營運狀況的反應，將是IPO過程中的關鍵。部分投資人在周三的會議前表示，Anthropic合理估值約落在1.8兆至2兆美元之間。
根據彭博先前的報導，Anthropic預期IPO規模將追平、或是超越SpaceX(SPCX-US)的上市規模。

OpenAI與Meta競爭升溫 AI安全疑慮成上市變數

Anthropic在今年大部分時間裡都保持強勁發展的氣勢，如今再度面臨來自OpenAI和Meta(META-US)等競爭對手的壓力。
在估值競賽方面，目前Anthropic和OpenAI勢均力敵，OpenAI近期以1.4兆美元估值為目標，尋求300億美元新一輪融資。然而，在AI代理程式發生多起失控的駭客事件之後，市場對AI安全的疑慮日益升高，可能影響到Anthropic的IPO。
另一方面，Meta Platforms(META-US)推出新款AI模型後，也成為投資人需要關注的競爭對手。Meta表示，新模型Muse Wonder與旗下前代產品相比有重大進展，在程式設計、處理金融或法律問題等能力方面，已可媲美OpenAI的ChatGPT與Anthropic的Claude。

全球IPO市場延宕增添變數

若Anthropic繼續推進IPO，將打破全球新股上市市場近期接連延後或取消上市計畫的趨勢。
資料中心營運商AirTrunk已將在新加坡上市不動產投資信託(REIT)的計畫延至明年。不久前，澳洲資料中心業者Firmus原定的IPO計畫已告吹。
paras_en: Sources familiar with the matter said AI model developer Anthropic disclosed at a closed‑door investor meeting on Wednesday (the 14th) that Q3 revenue hit $16.8 billion and the quarter posted adjusted profit, and that the company plans to kick off its IPO marketing campaign as early as the week of November 9.

The Financial Times, Bloomberg and other outlets, citing the same sources, reported that Anthropic told potential investors at a briefing at its San Francisco headquarters on Wednesday that it had turned an adjusted‑basis profit in Q3. Revenue for the quarter was $16.8 billion, up nearly 50 % from $11.5 billion in Q2.

Earlier foreign‑media reports said Anthropic expects to begin formal IPO marketing in the week of November 9, aiming to start trading before Thanksgiving and to list no later than the end of the year.
However, insiders said discussions are still ongoing and the timeline could be adjusted further. Anthropic’s spokesperson declined to comment.

Investors’ reaction to Anthropic’s latest operating results will be a key factor in the IPO process. Some investors told the Wednesday meeting that they see a reasonable valuation for Anthropic in the $1.8‑$2 trillion range.
According to earlier Bloomberg reporting, Anthropic’s IPO size is expected to match or exceed the listing size of SpaceX (SPCX‑US).
Competition with OpenAI and Meta is heating up, and AI‑safety concerns have become a variable for the listing.

In the valuation race, Anthropic and OpenAI are currently neck‑and‑neck; OpenAI recently targeted a $1.4 trillion valuation and is seeking a $30 billion new financing round. However, after several runaway AI‑agent hacking incidents, market worries about AI safety are rising and could affect Anthropic’s IPO.

On the other hand, Meta Platforms (META‑US) has launched a new AI model that investors are now watching as a competitor. Meta said its new model, Muse Wonder, shows major improvements over its predecessor and, in coding, financial‑or‑legal problem solving, can rival OpenAI’s ChatGPT and Anthropic’s Claude.
If Anthropic proceeds with its IPO, it would break the recent trend of global new‑stock listings being delayed or cancelled.

Data‑center operator AirTrunk has pushed back its plan to list a Singapore real‑estate investment trust (REIT) to next year, and not long ago Australian data‑center firm Firmus saw its IPO plan fall through.

items.title: 第7次挑戰成功！蘋果收盤市值終於站上5兆美元大關
items.title_en: Seventh Challenge Succeeds! Apple’s Closing Market Cap Finally Tops $5 Trillion
paras: 蘋果 (AAPL-US) 週三 (14 日) 逆勢上漲，收盤市值首度突破5兆美元，成為繼輝達 (NVDA-US) 之後，第二家達成這項里程碑的企業。
蘋果股價上漲0.5%，收在342.96美元，創歷史收盤新高，市值達5.005兆美元，僅次於市值約5.3兆美元的輝達。
蘋果此前曾有6次在盤中觸及5兆美元市值，但直到週三，才首次以超過這道門檻的市值收盤。
科技股承壓 蘋果逆勢創高
這項里程碑出現在科技股普遍走弱的一天，那斯達克綜合指數週三下跌約1.9%，蘋果卻逆勢創下收盤新高。今年以來，蘋果股價已上漲26%，優於標普500指數約13%的漲幅。
市場分析，蘋果的逆勢表現反映其對尋求避風港的資金仍具吸引力。
其他科技巨頭正投入龐大資本，建置人工智慧 (AI) 基礎設施，對自由現金流形成壓力；蘋果則採取較為節制的支出策略，投入金額遠低於其他大型科技同業。
iPhone需求解讀 Duo成下一場考驗
對於支撐蘋果股價的iPhone需求，外媒看法並不一致。
《AppleInsider》認為，iPhone 18 Pro的需求可能是推升市值的主要因素，並指出，儘管先前傳出零組件減產消息，蘋果股價仍在一週內由跌勢中回升。
線上訂購iPhone 18 Pro Max約需等待3週出貨。不過，相較往年，今年新機上市後，交期較晚才拉長至3週。這可能反映蘋果「供貨能力」優於預期，但交期變化仍不足以單獨判定需求強弱。
《巴隆週刊》則指出，部分數據顯示上月上市的iPhone 18 Pro需求可能不足。由於iPhone銷售是蘋果最重要的營收來源，這也使即將上市的摺疊機iPhone Duo，成為檢驗市場需求的關鍵。
蘋果上月宣布推出旗下首款摺疊智慧型手機iPhone Duo，將於週五 (16 日) 開放預購，並在10月23日正式上市，起價為1,999美元，是蘋果至今推出最昂貴的iPhone。
華爾街希望Pro系列需求偏弱，是因為消費者正在等待價格更高的Duo。若Duo上市後的需求未能支持這項期待，蘋果股價及剛達成的5兆美元市值，都可能面臨壓力。
美國銀行分析師 Wamsi Mohan 指出，投資人看好蘋果的部分原因，在於消費者願意為其產品支付更高價格，因此即使利潤率下滑，蘋果仍可能維持甚至提高整體獲利。
他還指出，蘋果新款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo 可望受到市場歡迎，搭載 AI 功能的新版 Siri 也有望帶動 iPhone 換機需求。
年底假期通常是蘋果最重要的銷售旺季，但 iPhone 18，以及可能的iPhone 18e或iPhone Air 2，將延至2027年春季推出，可能改變今年的銷售節奏。
分批推出新品可能使需求由Pro系列逐步轉向標準版，延續iPhone的營收動能。
服務業務表現，以及外界期待已久的Siri AI功能改善，也將是觀察蘋果後續成長的重要因素。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) rose against the trend on Wednesday the 14th, closing with a market cap that broke the $5 trillion barrier for the first time, becoming the second company after Nvidia (NVDA-US) to achieve this milestone.
Apple’s share price rose 0.5% to $342.96, setting a new all‑time closing high and pushing its market value to $5.005 trillion, second only to Nvidia’s roughly $5.3 trillion market cap.
Apple had previously touched a $5 trillion market value six times during trading sessions, but it was not until Wednesday that it closed above that threshold for the first time.
Tech stocks under pressure, Apple bucks the trend to set a new high

The milestone came on a day when tech stocks were broadly weakening, with the Nasdaq Composite down about 1.9% on Wednesday, yet Apple posted a new closing high against the tide. So far this year Apple’s stock has risen 26%, outpacing the S&P 500’s roughly 13% gain.
Market analysts say Apple’s contrarian performance reflects its continued appeal as a safe‑haven for capital.

Other tech giants are pouring massive capital into building AI infrastructure, putting pressure on free cash flow; Apple, by contrast, is following a more restrained spending approach, investing far less than its large‑cap peers.
iPhone demand interpretation: Duo becomes the next test
Views abroad differ on the iPhone demand that underpins Apple’s stock price.

AppleInsider believes demand for the iPhone 18 Pro could be the main driver of the market‑cap boost, noting that despite earlier rumors of component cuts, Apple’s shares rebounded within a week from a decline.

Online orders for the iPhone 18 Pro Max are expected to ship in about three weeks. However, compared with previous years, the lead time has lengthened to three weeks after the new model’s launch this year. This may indicate Apple’s supply capability is better than expected, but the change in lead time alone is insufficient to gauge demand strength.

Baron Weekly points out that some data suggest demand for the iPhone 18 Pro launched last month may be lacking. Since iPhone sales are Apple’s most important revenue source, this also makes the upcoming foldable iPhone Duo a key test of market demand.

Apple announced last month its first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, which will open for pre‑orders on Friday the 16th and officially launch on October 23 at a starting price of $1,999, making it the most expensive iPhone Apple has released to date.

Wall Street hopes the Pro‑series demand is weak because consumers are waiting for the higher‑priced Duo. If Duo’s launch demand falls short of expectations, Apple’s stock and its newly achieved $5 trillion market cap could face pressure.

Bank of America analyst Wamsi Mohan notes that part of the optimism about Apple stems from consumers’ willingness to pay higher prices for its products, so even if margins shrink, Apple could still maintain or even increase overall profitability.
He also says the new iPhone Duo is likely to be well received, and the AI‑enhanced Siri in the new version could spur iPhone upgrade cycles.

The holiday season at year‑end is usually Apple’s biggest sales period, but the iPhone 18—and possibly an iPhone 18e or iPhone Air 2—are now slated for a spring 2027 release, which could alter this year’s sales rhythm.
Staggered product rollouts may shift demand gradually from the Pro line to the standard models, sustaining iPhone revenue momentum.
Service business performance and the long‑awaited improvements to Siri’s AI capabilities will also be key indicators of Apple’s future growth.

items.title: 投資人需重整AI投資策略？高盛示警AI生態系分流、美中「雙強」格局成形
items.title_en: Should Investors Revise Their AI Investment Strategies? Goldman Sachs Warns of AI Ecosystem Split and Emerging US‑China Dual‑Power Landscape
paras: 美中人工智慧（AI）產業逐漸走向不同發展路線，可能改變全球投資人布局AI相關資產的方式。高盛最新分析指出，市場愈來愈認同全球AI產業正形成以美國與中國為核心的兩大生態系，兩者在地緣政治、國家安全及經濟成長考量下各自發展，可能是時候投資人需要重新思考AI投資策略。
根據《Business insider》報導，高盛策略師Kinger Lau領軍的團隊在週日發布的報告中指出，「全球AI雙強格局」的敘事正逐漸受到投資人關注。
策略師指出，一個AI生態系以美國及其主要貿易夥伴為核心，另一個則正在中國成形，反映地緣政治、國家安全及經濟成長等考量。
高盛指出，中國AI產業的進展已不再侷限於支援全球AI建設所需的供應鏈。從DeepSeek、Kimi等大型語言模型的突破，到半導體封裝、運算、生物工程及航太領域的進展，都顯示中國正持續擴大技術布局。
該行指出，中國也正打造涵蓋先進晶片、開放權重大型語言模型及AI應用的完整生態系，未來可能與美國主導的AI產業體系競爭。
策略師寫道：「重要的是，中國與西方之間的技術差距似乎正在縮小。」
他們還補充說，儘管中國在最先進的半導體技術方面仍落後數個世代，但在部分AI運算能力、基礎設施、模型及實體AI應用領域，中國可能已達到與全球競爭者相當的水準，甚至處於領先地位。
隨著美中AI生態系逐漸分流，高盛也調整中國AI股票的投資分類，不再將相關企業視為同一類資產，而是區分為兩大群組：一類是受惠於西方AI投資支出的出口導向企業，另一類則是受中國自身AI投資、應用普及及政策支持帶動的內需型企業。
高盛策略師指出，出口導向企業對全球AI投資趨勢及地緣政治局勢較為敏感；以中國內需市場為主的企業，則與中國AI支出及政府政策有更密切的關聯。
兩類企業的市場表現已出現差異。高盛數據顯示，從2025年初至2026年6月，中國AI出口導向企業股價累計上漲126%，但在全球AI股票遭遇賣壓期間，股價也從高點回落23%。
相較之下，中國內需型AI企業在市場修正後展現較強韌性。
高盛指出，自2025年初DeepSeek引發市場關注以來，受惠於股價上漲及新股上市，中國AI相關上市公司的市值合計增加近5兆美元。
AI相關股票在中國股市中的重要性也持續提高。高盛指出，目前中國境內及香港上市的中國股票，其合計股市總市值中，AI相關股票占比已從2024年的24%升至42%。
同時，AI相關股票的成交額占比也從48%升至57%。
paras_en: U.S. and Chinese artificial intelligence (AI) industries are gradually taking divergent development paths, which could reshape how global investors allocate AI‑related assets. Goldman Sachs' latest analysis notes that the market is increasingly recognizing two major AI ecosystems centered on the United States and China, each evolving under geopolitical, national‑security and growth considerations, and investors may need to rethink their AI strategies.

According to Business Insider, a Goldman Sachs team led by strategist Kinger Lau released a report on Sunday highlighting that the narrative of a "global AI dual‑power landscape" is gaining investor attention.

The strategists point out that one AI ecosystem is anchored by the United States and its key trading partners, while another is coalescing around China, reflecting geopolitical, security and growth factors.

Goldman notes that China's AI progress is no longer limited to supporting the global AI supply chain. Breakthroughs from large language models such as DeepSeek and Kimi, as well as advances in semiconductor packaging, computing, biotech and aerospace, show China is expanding its technological footprint.

The firm adds that China is building a complete ecosystem that includes advanced chips, open‑weight large language models and AI applications, which could eventually compete with the U.S.‑led AI industry framework.
The strategists write: "Importantly, the technology gap between China and the West appears to be narrowing."

They further note that although China still lags several generations behind in the most advanced semiconductor technology, it may have reached parity—or even leadership—in certain AI compute capabilities, infrastructure, models and physical AI applications compared with global rivals.

As the U.S. and Chinese AI ecosystems diverge, Goldman has re‑classified Chinese AI stocks, no longer treating them as a single asset class but splitting them into two groups: export‑oriented firms that benefit from Western AI investment spending, and domestic‑demand firms driven by China’s own AI investment, adoption and policy support.

The strategists say export‑oriented companies are more sensitive to global AI investment trends and geopolitical dynamics, while firms focused on China’s domestic market are more closely tied to Chinese AI spending and government policy.

The two groups have already shown different market performance. Goldman data show that from early 2025 to June 2026, Chinese AI export‑oriented stocks rose 126% cumulatively, but fell 23% from their peaks during a period of global AI stock sell‑off.
In contrast, Chinese domestic‑demand AI firms displayed greater resilience after the market correction.

Goldman points out that since DeepSeek attracted market attention in early 2025, the combined market capitalization of listed Chinese AI companies has grown by nearly $5 trillion, boosted by price gains and new listings.

AI‑related stocks are becoming increasingly important in China’s equity markets. Goldman notes that AI stocks now account for 42% of the total market value of China‑ and Hong Kong‑listed Chinese shares, up from 24% in 2024.
At the same time, the share of trading volume attributable to AI stocks has risen from 48% to 57%.

items.title: 戴爾重挫11%標普吊車尾 分析師質疑上漲空間有限
items.title_en: Dell plunges 11% as S&P lagging; analysts question limited upside
paras: 《MarketWatch》週三(14日)報導，戴爾科技(Dell Technologies)(DELL-US)與慧與科技(Hewlett Packard Enterprise)(HPE-US)股價今年表現亮眼，但有分析師質疑，這兩檔股票的後續上漲空間是否已經有限。
戴爾在2026年至今上漲逾300%，慧與科技則上漲163%。兩家公司都銷售AI伺服器，在需求大幅攀升帶動下，未交貨訂單積壓量也持續增加。不過，巴克萊分析師Tim Long質疑，這兩檔股票的漲勢是否真的如投資人所想，主要受到人工智慧題材推動。
Long認為，戴爾「與AI投資趨勢相當一致」，但他將戴爾股價出色的表現，主要歸因於公司抵銷記憶體價格變動影響的能力。
戴爾憑藉用於AI最佳化的資料中心伺服器，受惠於AI熱潮。Long預估，這項業務在截至明年1月的本會計年度，營收將成長至750億美元，達到原先的三倍。
然而，Long表示，記憶體價格可能逐漸回歸正常水準，甚至可能在未來兩年開始下跌，進而拖慢戴爾AI伺服器營收的成長速度。他補充，這也可能限制戴爾股價進一步上漲的空間。
Long將戴爾股票評級從加碼下調至中立，並將目標價從603美元下修至574美元。戴爾股價週三收盤下跌11.4%，至507.43美元，在標普500指數成分股中，跌幅第二大。
根據道瓊市場數據，戴爾股價週三的單日跌幅，創下2025年4月3日下跌19%以來最大紀錄。
Long表示，慧與科技的伺服器與儲存業務，也受惠於記憶體零組件平均售價上升。因此，隨著相關成本回歸正常水準，他預期該公司股價未來的上漲空間將更加有限。他同樣將慧與科技的股票評級下調至中立。
Long表示，他目前尚未在這兩家公司身上「看到AI帶來的顯著轉折」。他原先預期，企業採用AI將帶動對更多相關硬體的需求，進而推升營收。然而，目前為止，記憶體成本對企業相關營收的影響，比企業轉向AI所帶來的影響更大。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported on Wednesday (the 14th) that Dell Technologies (DELL‑US) and Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE‑US) have posted standout stock performance this year, but some analysts wonder whether further upside for the two stocks is now limited.

Dell has risen more than 300% since 2026, while HPE is up 163%. Both companies sell AI servers, and the surge in demand has driven a growing backlog of undelivered orders. However, Barclays analyst Tim Long questions whether the rally in these stocks is truly driven by the AI theme as investors believe.

Long says Dell’s performance is “very much in line with the AI investment trend,” but he attributes the stock’s strong gains mainly to the company’s ability to offset the impact of memory‑price fluctuations.

Dell benefits from AI‑optimized data‑center servers riding the AI boom. Long forecasts that this business will generate $75 billion in revenue for the fiscal year ending January next year, roughly three times its current level.

Long cautions that memory prices may gradually normalize and could even start to decline over the next two years, which would slow the growth rate of Dell’s AI‑server revenue and could cap further stock appreciation.

Long downgraded Dell’s rating from “add” to “neutral” and cut the price target from $603 to $574. Dell’s shares closed down 11.4% on Wednesday at $507.43, the second‑largest decline among S&P 500 constituents.
According to Dow Jones market data, Dell’s single‑day drop on Wednesday was the biggest since a 19% fall on April 3, 2025.

Long noted that HPE’s server and storage businesses have also benefited from higher average selling prices for memory components. As those costs return to normal, he expects the company’s upside potential to become even more limited and has similarly lowered HPE’s rating to neutral.

Long said he has not yet seen a “significant AI‑driven inflection” at either company. He originally expected corporate AI adoption to spur demand for more related hardware and boost revenue, but so far the impact of memory costs on corporate revenue has outweighed the effect of the shift toward AI.

items.title: AI資料中心需求強勁卻難蓋! 馬斯克: 籌到錢只是第一關 電力、散熱與網路都是瓶頸
items.title_en: Strong AI Data Center Demand Yet Hard to Build! Musk: Raising Money Is Only the First Hurdle, Power, Cooling and Network Are Bottlenecks
paras: 馬斯克警告, 人工智慧 (AI) 資料中心市場雖然需求強勁, 但取得資金並不代表企業就能順利完成建置。SpaceX 創辦人馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 近日指出, 建造超級電腦資料中心涉及龐大的電力、散熱及網路系統, 工程複雜程度遠超單純籌資, 即使 SpaceX 擁有頂尖團隊, 仍發現相關建置工作極具挑戰。
馬斯克周二 (13日) 在社群平台 X 發文表示, 「超級電腦資料中心的需求確實非常強勁, 但取得資金來建造具有龐大電力、散熱及網路需求的複雜硬體系統, 與真正把它建造出來並不是同一回事。」他並指出, SpaceX 擁有實力非常強大的團隊, 在軌道運載能力方面領先其他業者一個數量級, 但即使如此, 要完成這些建設仍然非常困難。
馬斯克的發言, 是針對市場對 AI 基礎設施融資風險升高的討論所作出的回應。近年科技企業大舉投入 AI 運算能力, 推動資料中心、伺服器、晶片及電力設施的資本支出快速增加, 但投資人開始更加關注企業能否將鉅額融資轉化為實際營運能力與現金流。

AI 雲端運算服務商 CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 與甲骨文 (Oracle) (ORCL-US) 都是 AI 基礎設施擴建的重要參與者, 但市場對相關企業的負債、融資成本及未來投資回報愈來愈謹慎。CoreWeave 的2032年到期債券殖利率近期一度升至約15%, 顯示債券投資人要求更高報酬, 以承擔企業擴張及信用風險。市場也開始質疑, 若 AI 運算需求成長不如預期, 或資料中心建置進度落後, 業者是否仍能負擔龐大的利息及資本支出。

馬斯克的警告也與 SpaceX 自身的 AI 基礎設施計畫密切相關。SpaceX 正積極擴大超級電腦與資料中心建置, 並尋求大量資金採購輝達 (NVIDIA) (NVDA-US) 的 AI 晶片。根據《路透社》先前報導, SpaceX 正尋求約400億美元融資採購輝達晶片, 規劃透過銀行貸款籌集約100億美元, 另發行約300億美元投資級債券。這項融資規模凸顯, 建置先進 AI 運算基礎設施所需的資本已達到數百億美元等級。

在實際建置方面, SpaceX 旗下的 Colossus 超級電腦最初在122天內完成建置, 之後擴充至搭載20萬顆輝達 H100 GPU, 並規劃進一步將運算規模提升至100萬顆 GPU。馬斯克也曾表示, Colossus 2 未來可能搭載超過120萬顆輝達 GB200 與 GB300 晶片。這些計畫顯示, AI 運算能力的擴張不只是採購晶片, 還必須同步完成機房、供電、散熱、網路及其他配套系統。
特斯拉 (Tesla) (TSLA-US) 也持續擴大 AI 運算設施。公司第二季文件指出, 位於德州的 Cortex 1 與 Cortex 2 系統提供超過205百萬瓦的生產運算能力, 並計畫在年底前進一步擴建。如此大規模的運算設施需要穩定且充足的電力供應, 同時必須有效管理晶片產生的熱量, 以維持設備運作與系統可靠性。
資料中心產業的挑戰不僅在於資金與硬體, 電力取得、冷卻效率及高速網路連接同樣可能限制建置速度。即使企業已經取得晶片訂單與融資承諾, 若電網接入、供電設施、冷卻系統或網路設備無法及時到位, 整座資料中心仍可能無法按計畫投入營運。這也意味著, AI 基礎設施投資的成敗, 不只取決於企業能投入多少資本, 更取決於工程執行、設備整合及營運管理能力。
馬斯克的布局甚至延伸至太空資料中心。SpaceX 計畫利用太陽能供電、輻射散熱及 Starlink 雷射通訊鏈路, 探索在軌道部署 AI 運算設施, 以降低地面資料中心對土地、電網及傳統冷卻設備的依賴。馬斯克認為, 太空可能是未來大規模擴展運算能力的重要方向之一。
然而, 太空資料中心仍面臨極高的工程與經濟門檻。設備必須承受嚴苛的太空環境, 高效能晶片的散熱方式也與地面機房不同, 此外還涉及發射成本、設備維修及硬體升級等問題。即使 SpaceX 擁有火箭發射與衛星網路技術優勢, 要將這些能力轉化為具商業可行性的太空運算服務, 仍需要克服多項技術障礙。
對 AI 資料中心投資人而言, 馬斯克的說法凸顯產業評價標準正在改變。過去市場主要關注晶片供應、運算需求及企業能否取得資金, 如今隨著投資規模持續擴大, 電力、散熱、網路、建置時程與融資成本也成為決定投資回報的重要因素。
AI 運算需求持續成長, 並不代表所有資料中心業者都能順利獲利。企業即使取得大量融資, 若建置進度延誤、營運成本過高, 或客戶需求無法支撐預期收入, 仍可能面臨現金流壓力。隨著市場對 AI 基礎設施投資的審查日益嚴格, 投資人除了評估資金規模及晶片採購能力, 也必須檢視企業的工程執行力、基礎設施建置效率及長期獲利能力。
paras_en: Musk warned that although the AI data‑center market is booming, securing financing does not guarantee a company can complete construction. SpaceX founder Elon Musk recently pointed out that building super‑computer data centers involves massive power, cooling and networking systems, and the engineering complexity far exceeds simple fundraising; even with SpaceX’s top‑tier team, the related work remains highly challenging.

Musk posted on X on Tuesday the 13th that “the demand for super‑computer data centers is indeed very strong, but raising money to build hardware systems with huge power, cooling and networking needs is not the same as actually building them.” He added that SpaceX has an exceptionally strong team and leads other players by an order of magnitude in orbital launch capability, yet completing these builds is still extremely difficult.

Musk’s remarks were a response to growing discussion about rising financing risk for AI infrastructure. In recent years tech firms have poured capital into AI compute, driving rapid growth in data‑center, server, chip and power‑facility spending, but investors are now scrutinizing whether companies can turn massive financing into real operating capacity and cash flow.

AI cloud providers CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) and Oracle (ORCL‑US) are key players in AI infrastructure expansion, but the market is becoming more cautious about their debt, financing costs and future returns. CoreWeave’s 2032 bond yield recently spiked to about 15%, indicating investors demand higher compensation for expansion and credit risk. The market also questions whether firms can shoulder large interest and cap‑ex bills if AI demand falls short or data‑center roll‑outs lag.

Musk’s warning is closely tied to SpaceX’s own AI infrastructure plans. SpaceX is actively expanding super‑computers and data centers and seeking massive funding to buy NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) AI chips. Reuters previously reported that SpaceX is looking for roughly $40 billion in financing to purchase NVIDIA chips, planning about $10 billion in bank loans and issuing about $30 billion of investment‑grade bonds. This financing scale highlights that capital needed for advanced AI compute infrastructure now runs into the hundreds of billions of dollars.

In practice, SpaceX’s Colossus super‑computer was built in an initial 122‑day sprint, then expanded to house 200,000 NVIDIA H100 GPUs, with plans to scale to one million GPUs. Musk has also said that a future Colossus 2 could host over 1.2 million NVIDIA GB200 and GB300 chips. These plans show that expanding AI compute power is not just about buying chips but also completing data‑hall, power, cooling, networking and other supporting systems in tandem.

Tesla (TSLA‑US) is also expanding its AI compute facilities. Its Q2 filing noted that the Cortex 1 and Cortex 2 systems in Texas provide more than 205 MW of production compute capacity, with further expansion planned before year‑end. Such large‑scale facilities require stable, ample power supply and effective heat management to keep equipment running and systems reliable.

The data‑center industry’s challenges go beyond capital and hardware; power availability, cooling efficiency and high‑speed network connectivity can also limit build speed. Even if a company secures chip orders and financing commitments, a lack of grid connection, power infrastructure, cooling systems or network gear can prevent a data center from becoming operational on schedule. Thus the success of AI infrastructure investment depends not only on how much capital a firm can raise but also on engineering execution, equipment integration and operational management.

Musk’s vision even extends to space‑based data centers. SpaceX plans to use solar power, radiation cooling and Starlink laser links to explore orbital AI compute deployments, reducing reliance on land, grid and traditional cooling for ground data centers. Musk believes space could become a major avenue for massive compute expansion in the future.

However, space data centers face extremely high engineering and economic barriers. Equipment must survive harsh space conditions, and high‑performance chip cooling differs from ground‑based solutions; launch costs, maintenance and hardware upgrades also add complexity. Even with SpaceX’s launch and satellite‑network advantages, turning these capabilities into commercially viable space compute services will require overcoming numerous technical hurdles.

For AI data‑center investors, Musk’s comments highlight a shift in industry valuation criteria. Previously the market focused mainly on chip supply, compute demand and a firm’s ability to raise money; now, as investment scales grow, power, cooling, networking, build timelines and financing costs have become key determinants of investment returns.

Growing AI compute demand does not guarantee profitability for all data‑center operators. Even with abundant financing, companies can face cash‑flow pressure if build schedules slip, operating costs soar, or customer demand falls short of revenue expectations. As scrutiny of AI infrastructure investments tightens, investors must assess not only funding size and chip‑buying capacity but also a firm’s engineering execution, infrastructure build efficiency and long‑term profit potential.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元觸及18個月高點後回落 投資人預期Fed仍將保持耐心
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Falls After Reaching 18-Month High as Investors Expect Fed to Remain Patient
paras: 美元周三(14日)觸及至18個月高點，美國通膨數據強於預期，一度重新點燃市場對聯準會(Fed)可能在本月稍晚升息的預期。不過，隨著投資人重新預期聯準會將保持耐心，美元隨後自高點回落。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.34%，報102.53，稍早在上午尾盤一度升至102.94。
美國勞工部勞工統計局公布的數據顯示，由於汽油價格大幅上漲，美國9月消費者物價明顯攀升。
State Street資深全球市場策略師Marvin Loh表示，「CPI數據仍在影響市場估值，而股市下跌又提供了另一個推升美元的理由。」
這份通膨報告蓋過了聯準會官員近期釋出的鴿派訊號，包括紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)的言論。他的評論曾在前一個交易日導致美元走弱。
聯準會負責監管事務的副主席鮑曼(Michelle Bowman)週四也釋出訊號，表示在再次升息之前，將採取觀望態度。
另一方面，聯準會週三公布的「褐皮書」顯示，美國勞動市場仍處於「低聘僱、低解僱」狀態，但部分地區的通膨壓力有所升高。
Mesirow Currency Management資深投資策略師Uto Shinohara表示，「聯準會的雙重使命與勞動市場疲弱的跡象之間，仍存在拉鋸。明天公布的零售銷售、初領失業救濟金人數及生產者物價指數(PPI)，應能讓我們更清楚掌握消費者狀況、勞動市場與物價壓力。」
芝商所(CME Group)的FedWatch工具顯示，交易員目前預期聯準會在10月27日至28日的會議上維持利率不變的機率為65%，高於一個月前的53%。市場預期截至2027年底，累計緊縮幅度約為79個基點。
美國央行上個月將政策利率調升0.25個百分點，使利率區間升至3.75%至4.00%。
Angeles Investments投資長Michael Rosen表示，投資人對美國是否願意採取行動抑制通膨，正逐漸失去信心。
Rosen表示，「我們看到……美元走強受到較高利率的支撐。除非聯準會大幅升息、促使經濟陷入衰退，或是我們修正貿易與移民政策，否則通膨不會下降。」
歐元面臨壓力
多國財政與金融主管目前齊聚曼谷，出席國際貨幣基金(IMF)與世界銀行(World Bank)的年度會議。
IMF財政事務主管Rodrigo Valdes表示，IMF已提高對各國政府控制不斷攀升債務的呼籲力度。IMF總裁Kristalina Georgieva則表示，美國需要進行財政調整，讓債務走上更可持續的道路。
法國公債是近期全球債券拋售潮中受衝擊最嚴重市場之一。投資人擔心，明年總統大選前的政治角力，可能阻礙法國降低高額財政赤字的努力。
歐洲央行(ECB)總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)在曼谷出席CNN活動時表示，法國應透過財政整頓解決債務問題。這番言論降低了市場對歐洲央行可能開始買進法國公債、以壓低殖利率的猜測。
由於油價上漲，加上市場持續擔憂法國的財政狀況，歐元進一步承壓。
歐元下跌0.41%，至1.1152美元，兌美元匯率創下17個月新低，兌英鎊則跌至16個月新低。
UniCredit外匯策略師Roberto Mialich表示，歐元短期內可能測試1.10美元，但對年底前的歐元走勢，他的看法沒有那麼悲觀。他預期，「美國公債殖利率可能回落，儘管歐元區情勢仍可能對歐元構成壓力。」

paras_en: The dollar hit an 18‑month high on Wednesday (the 14th) as U.S. inflation data came in stronger than expected, briefly reigniting market expectations that the Federal Reserve might raise rates later this month. However, as investors revised their outlook to see the Fed staying patient, the dollar retreated from its peak.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.34% to 102.53, after having briefly climbed to 102.94 earlier in the session.
Data released by the U.S. Labor Department’s Bureau of Labor Statistics showed that September’s consumer price index rose sharply, driven by a large jump in gasoline prices.
State Street senior global markets strategist Marvin Loh said, “CPI data is still influencing market valuations, and the stock market decline provides another reason to push the dollar higher.”

The inflation report eclipsed recent dovish signals from Fed officials, including comments from New York Fed President John Williams, whose remarks had weakened the dollar on the previous trading day.
Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman also signaled on Thursday that the central bank would adopt a wait‑and‑see stance before any further rate hikes.
Meanwhile, the Fed’s Beige Book released on Wednesday showed that the U.S. labor market remains in a “low‑hiring, low‑layoff” environment, though inflation pressures have risen in some regions.

Mesirow Currency Management senior investment strategist Uto Shinohara said, “The Fed’s dual mandate is still at odds with signs of a weakening labor market. Tomorrow’s retail sales, initial jobless claims and producer price index (PPI) data should give us a clearer picture of consumer conditions, the labor market and price pressures.”

CME Group’s FedWatch tool shows traders now assign a 65% probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged at its Oct. 27‑28 meeting, up from 53% a month ago. The market expects a cumulative tightening of about 79 basis points by the end of 2027.
The U.S. central bank raised its policy rate by 0.25 percentage point last month, moving the target range to 3.75%‑4.00%.
Angeles Investments chief investment officer Michael Rosen said investors are losing confidence that the United States will take decisive action to curb inflation.

Rosen added, “We see the dollar’s strength being supported by higher rates. Unless the Fed hikes aggressively enough to push the economy into recession, or we overhaul trade and immigration policy, inflation won’t come down.”
Euro Under Pressure
Finance and central‑bank leaders from multiple countries are gathered in Bangkok for the International Monetary Fund and World Bank annual meetings.

IMF finance chief Rodrigo Valdes said the Fund has stepped up its calls for governments to rein in soaring debt. IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva added that the United States needs fiscal adjustments to put its debt on a more sustainable path.

French sovereign bonds have been among the hardest hit in the recent global bond sell‑off. Investors worry that political battles ahead of next year’s presidential election could hamper France’s efforts to reduce its large fiscal deficit.

European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde, speaking at a CNN event in Bangkok, said France should address its debt problem through fiscal consolidation. Her remarks dampened market speculation that the ECB might start buying French bonds to lower yields.
Higher oil prices and continued concerns about France’s fiscal health have added further pressure on the euro.
The euro fell 0.41% to $1.1152, hitting a 17‑month low against the dollar and a 16‑month low against the pound.

UniCredit foreign‑exchange strategist Roberto Mialich said the euro could test $1.10 in the short term, but he is less pessimistic about its trajectory by year‑end, expecting “U.S. Treasury yields may retreat even though euro‑area conditions could still weigh on the euro.”

The Financial Times reported on Wednesday that UK Treasury Secretary John Healey expects all new spending announced in this month’s budget to be funded by tax hikes or cuts rather than additional borrowing.
An IMF senior official said the institution has not advised the United Kingdom to accelerate its fiscal consolidation pace.

paras: 觀望美國關鍵消費者物價指數(CPI)報告發布，加上台積電 (2330-TW) (TSM-US) 法說會前夕市場觀望氣氛濃厚，新台幣兌美元匯率今(14)日呈現震盪整理走勢。早盤隨台股開高帶動一度反彈，但隨後外資持續在台股提款並匯出，新台幣升幅逐步收斂，全天高低震盪波動，高低震盪達1.5角，持續在32元整數關卡上演攻防戰，最終以微升1.2分的32.073元兌 1 美元作收。
